3693-4659-5224-7692.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Shuri, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-8346.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Type-03 Borg Vessel.
If Type-03 Borg Vessel has at least seven charge counters on it, it triggers, creating a 1/1 colorless Borg artifact creature token.
Repeat.

728-3240-6462-8347.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

628-3967-7865.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

440-1786-7426-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1786-7426-7743.description:
Draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain life.
Well of Lost Dreams and Heroic Feast trigger.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

3322-4019-4221--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
3322-4019-4221--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

1580-4871-5686-7316.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1116-1580-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1020-2034-2866-3375.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by The Immortal Sun.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by The Immortal Sun.
Repeat.

104-5086-5183-5231-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-5086-5183-5231-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

3490-4659-7062.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Aang triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

229-3394-5220.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Weatherlight Compleated.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Endless One from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to put a phyresis counter on it and draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Spider you control without summoning sickness
attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

1729-2178-4410.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Hermetic Study attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

856-3899-4321-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3899-4321-5477.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-1849-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

2267-2558-5330--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2267-2558-5330--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Tormod triggers. Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

116-643-1486-1753.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
116-643-1486-1753.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

38-301-4535.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-4535.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Repeat.

1183-1365-1651-4659.notablePrerequisites: Pentavus does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1183-1365-1651-4659.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Pentavus persist until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Pentavus, adding {C}{C}.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pentavus' first ability twice by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from it, creating two 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Pentavus and a Pentavite, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colorless mana and Pentavite tokens, you may use Pentavus' second ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

638-819-3584.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery this turn.
638-819-3584.description:
Cast any other spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Cast Memory Lapse by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Thousand-Year Storm and Thrumming Stone trigger.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, creating at least one copy of Memory Lapse, with each copy targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Resolve the first copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
All remaining Memory Lapse copies fizzle due to no longer having a legal target.
Resolve the Thrumming Stone trigger from step 3, revealing the top four cards of your library and casting Memory Lapse without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.

951-1940-2972-5220.description:
Cast Shivan Devastator by paying {R}.
Shivan Devastator enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary, Ganax and Liliana trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shivan Devastator on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Shivan Devastator.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
